messages:
Sam W: RC build v1.12.0-rc1 is ready on the release runner. Cutoff is 17:00 PT today unless we see blockers. Need: version bump, changelog check, docs draft, QA smoke, and security signoff. Ping if you need extra time.
Maddie H: Changelog PR is open (PR #4662) — left one note about the breaking auth header behavior. Can fix quickly.
Jordan P: Noticed a stray migration on main, I'll open release/1.12.0-rc1-hotfix and cherry-pick the migration revert.
Arnav K: Doing security pre-checks now. Dependency scan shows a minor JWT warning (low severity). I'll create a patch PR and request expedited review.
Priya L: Docs: I started a draft of the release notes at docs/releases/1.12.0.md — needs one more screenshots update for the dashboard section.
QA Bot: smoke-suite: build 1.12.0-rc1 -> 12/12 smoke tests passed on the runner. Full regression queued, estimated runtime ~40m.
Sam W: Thanks. For version bump, use: `git checkout release/1.12.0-rc1 && jq '.version=\"1.12.0-rc1\"' package.json > tmp && mv tmp package.json && git commit -am \"bump: 1.12.0-rc1\" && git tag -a v1.12.0-rc1 -m \"RC1\" && git push origin release/1.12.0-rc1 --tags`
Maddie H: I can handle the changelog update and version bump. Will push in ~5m.
Jordan P: Hotfix branch created and merged into the release branch. Also removed the migration.
Sam W: If anyone needs extra time, say so now. Otherwise I'm willing to extend cutoff by 30m to 17:30 PT to let the regression finish.
Maddie H: Pushed changelog and bumped package.json. Tag pushed. PR #4662 updated.
Arnav K: Security PR #4678 created to update jwt dependency to 4.1.1 — tests passing locally, requesting @Sam W review for the patch cut.
Priya L: Updated screenshots, docs draft ready for review. Filed PR #4680.
QA Bot: regression: 0 failures so far, 10/10 suites complete, total run time 37m. Canary queue now awaiting cut.
Sam W: OK hearing green across the board. I'll cut the release at 17:30 PT and trigger canary. If anything is still blocked post-cut, we will fast-follow a patch.
Maddie H: :thumbsup: I'll monitor post-canary logs for obvious 500s.
Jordan P: :shipit: good work everyone.
QA Bot: Canary kickoff at 17:34 PT. Initial telemetry: increase in p50 on model-infer by ~12ms (under investigation).
